description: This file implements a YAML parser interface for controlling and configuring embedded systems, specifically for parsing and validating YAML files related to 'avbuffer' configurations. It provides functions to load YAML from files or memory, validate schemas, and extract specific configuration parameters such as buffer size, latency, stream ID, and format. It utilizes a key-value pair (KVP) internal library (ut_kvp) for the core parsing operations and offers a structured API for other components to interact with YAML configuration data.
